referenceObligationsConfirmed: Two-document initiating packet: agency notice and circuit-court petition
Participant is the filing actor and may proceed self-represented
File both documents concurrently no later than day 30 after receipt or service of the final Commission decision
Petition venue is the circuit court of the participant's county of residence or the county where the agency of record exists
Serve AJIC, the original agency of record, and every other party of record; registered or certified mail is sufficient on the agency
No advance bond or advance payment of costs under Ala. Code section 41-9-645; a contrary demand triggers legal review
Invoke de novo review and plead AJIC administrative exhaustion, the uncharged-arrest facts, jurisdiction, venue, challenged entry, grounds, and requested statutory correction or removal relief
Attach the challenged record, challenge and appeal materials, disposition proof, final decision, receipt-date proof, mail proof, and proposed order, plus locally required case-opening material
Stop when a material issue is contested or merits litigation is required
Do not use this branch for Title 15 expungement or for sealing or erasing court files
